messages:
Sophie: Vendor emailed — they can loan 12x L40S nodes in us-east1 for a 72h window starting Tue 2026-04-07 14:00 PT. Quick check: can we run inference bench + a small serving smoke test on that pool? Need AMI compatibility, driver/kernel version, and a transient quota bump. Who owns the AMI PR? cc @Arjun @Leo @Pooja :eyes:

Arjun: I own the AMI PR but it's still WIP. L40S needs nvidia-driver >=535 and CUDA 12.3; cuDNN 9.x. I have a draft at github.com/redwood/infra/ami-bakes/pull/834 — missing one kernel patch. I can finish it EOD tomorrow.

Leo: We currently don't have quota for 12 L40S in us-east1 on the demo billing project. @Pooja can you ask vendor/cloud for a transient quota token? Also: are these nodes part of our existing dedicated-demo project or a vendor-managed account (affects IAM)? If vendor can mix SKUs, we could do 8 A500 + 4 L40S as fallback. :thinking_face:

Pooja: Just pinged support@vendorcloud with the allocation request and explained temporary nature (72h). Asked for a machine-image compatibility note and whether hypervisor passthrough differs. Vendor created ticket #4521 and says ETA ~3-6h for token. I'll update here when they reply. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: Good. If AMI bake is tight, we can apply a bootstrap user-data fallback instead of baking a new AMI — acceptable for short windows. Also we should capture NVML/topology differences in the smoke tests.

Arjun: Agreed. Quick user-data snippet that should handle drivers and kernel bits (will test locally):

```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends linux-headers-$(uname -r) build-essential curl
curl -fsSL https://internal-repo.redwood/gpu-drivers/535/install.sh | bash
# sanity: nvidia-smi && python3 -m pip install -U -r /opt/bench/requirements.txt
```

This avoids a full AMI bake for a one-off run. But we should still land the AMI PR for repeatability.

Leo: Plan suggestion: 1) Pooja confirms token 2) Arjun lands minimal AMI PR or we use user-data fallback 3) Sophie schedules canary low-QPS run Tue 15:00 PT 4) Capture per-token latency, nvml stats, and driver logs. If topology looks weird, we abort and ask vendor for details.

vendor-notify-bot: Ticket #4521 created with vendor. Allocation token requested for 12x L40S in us-east1 for 72h. Vendor ETA 5h. Reference: https://vendor.example/ticket/4521

Pooja: Vendor replied: they can allocate in our project, token will be emailed. They flagged that some L40S SKUs use a different firmware image — recommended we run full nvml checks.

Arjun: I'll add a quick test to bench/shootout.sh to fail if nvml shows inconsistent topology or if drivers report unsupported compute capability. Will push a tiny PR now and label it gpu/ami-bake.

Sophie: Awesome. I'll reserve Tue 15:00 PT on infra-canaries and add the test checklist to the runbook. If vendor token arrives earlier we can move up. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
